scope: Read-only analysis of the supplied NT3.51 NDIS.SYS, not runtime completion proof

findings.NdisOpenAdapter: 0x12b4d-0x12b61 stores MAC pointer in open+0 and caches MAC send/transfer; 0x12bd6 passes open+4 for MAC binding context, 0x12bef dispatches MAC open+0x20. No NT4 cached ResetHandler is assumed.
findings.NdisRegisterMac: 0x14487-0x14496 copies 0x38 bytes of supplied MAC characteristics at MAC+0x18. NDIS 3.0 Reset/Request fields therefore reside at MAC+0x30/+0x34.
